algoTip: SHA-256 stands beside almost every download. MD5 and SHA-1 are enough to find transfer errors, but not against intent. BLAKE3 is the fastest.
noFiles: There is no file here for a checksum
saveFailed: The list could not be saved: {error}
fileTip: A list such as .sha256, .md5 or SHA256SUMS. The files are looked for in its folder.
pastePlaceholder: Checksum and file name, one line per file
pick: Paste checksums or pick a file
damagedHint: A file that differs is damaged or another version
partSizeTip: 4 GB fits a USB stick with FAT32. 100 MB gets through most mail and upload limits.
addSumTip: Puts a .sha256 of the whole file beside the parts. Combine checks the result with it.
smaller: The file is smaller than one part
pickPart: Pick a part such as file.001 first
name: Name
checkNone: That needs a .sha256 named after the whole file beside the parts.
dropPartsTip: The parts go to the trash once combining has worked.
takenTip: A file with this name is there already. It stays, the new one gets a number.
sumWrong: The checksum of {file} does not match. The parts stay where they are.
